task.title: AI Agent lecture Korean prose HTML notes
task.scope: Create and revise a Korean long-form HTML teaching handout for a 2-hour AI Agent lecture for WordPress website creators, including the user's head/hand analogy, agent tool installation framing, MCP automatic feedback loop, GitHub explanation, Naver-to-WordPress demo, and 100 practical use cases.

acceptanceCriteria: Lecture notes are Korean-first and written as continuous teaching prose, not only slide bullets.
Document includes the 2-hour lecture structure and a 35-45 slide storyboard.

Document includes chatbot vs agent, ChatGPT/Codex, Claude/Claude Code, Gemini/Google Antigravity, CLI, IDE, AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, Skills, Plugins, MCP, GitHub, closed-loop workflow, Naver-to-WordPress demo, and safe WordPress automation.
Document includes the user's MCP automatic feedback loop analogy and setup protocol with safety framing.
Document includes Antigravity and Codex installation/reference links.
Document includes links to Vercel Agent Skills, Anthropic Skills, Superpowers, and Karpathy-inspired CLAUDE.md.
Document includes approximately 100 WordPress/business use ideas.
Current MCP claims are tied to checked public sources and include a version/date caution.
qaScenarios: Static search confirms required Korean concepts are present.
HTML parses without obvious structural errors.
File can be opened in a browser for reading.
No real credentials or secrets are included.

decisions: The first lecture artifact is a Korean prose HTML handout before building a slide deck.
MCP automatic feedback loop content is included after the manual Naver-to-WordPress demo so beginners understand safety before automation.
preferences: User wants Korean teaching material first, in an HTML file, written as continuous explanatory prose.
constraints: Do not include real WordPress credentials or secrets in lecture artifacts.
Treat MCP write access as security-sensitive and frame it with staging, backup, limited permissions, rollback, and bounded retry guidance.
